children: Fly-E Group, Inc. reported results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 (three months ended June 30, 2026) with revenue of $2.75M, down from $5.33M a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to parent consolidated stockholders of $(3.94M), or diluted loss per share of $(2.41).
Revenue: $2.75M for Q1 FY2027, compared with $5.33M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change (48.4%).
Net income: Net loss attributable to parent consolidated stockholders of $(3.94M) for Q1 FY2027, versus net loss of $(2.01M) in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: Loss per share $(2.41) for Q1 FY2027, versus $(6.00) in the year-ago quarter (per retroactively adjusted shares).
Revenue trend: Net revenues fell 48.4% year over year to $2.75M, driven by sharp retail declines and lower unit sales.
Channel shift: Company saw a significant shift from retail to wholesale as store count dropped to four, increasing wholesale mix but at lower margins.
Brand and safety impact: Consumer demand was pressured by lithium‑battery safety incidents and related regulatory attention, notably affecting the NYC market.
Product and offerings: Maintained a portfolio of 27 e-motorcycles, 37 e-bikes and 38 e-scooters; continued rental service and launched the Go Fly app for rentals.
Operational milestones: Completed ERP and Go Fly app development, assembled vehicles in Maspeth, NY, and streamlined vendor management.
